programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insisting instead to blade both rounds himself. As all of the others vie for the last spot, Kai's frustration at his lack of control with his new Hard Metal Beyblade reaches an all-time high, combine that with his anger at what happened to Tala, and Kai's mood is even less cheery than usual. It isn't until he connects with an unlikely Blading opponent that he gains the technique he's been seeking for so long'the real question is, will Tyson and the rest of the gang welcome Kai back after all they've been through in the past?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the continuation of the Justice 5 Tournament with the BEGA Blader's leading the battle with two wins and a tie. If G Revolutions lose the next battle, they're out and BEGA (lead by the evil Boris) takes over the Beyblading Empire. The next battle is set to pit Tyson against Garland, but when the G Revolutions enter the stadium, they reveal their fifth team member- KAI!! Everyone is stunned, except for the BEGA Blader's who see him only as a loser. Kai is out for revenge because a few days earlier he lost a battle to Brooklyn. So, wanting to save face, Kai calls out Brooklyn, who arrogantly accepts his challenge. A massive battle ensues with Kai trying desperately to somehow attack his opponent, but nothing seems to work. And what's worse, Brooklyn seems to be copying Kai's every move. Kai becomes frustrated and realizes he must dig deep within himself to draw out more power. He does, however, it's making him weaker and weaker. The rest of the G Revolutions team wants him to quit. Kai refuses and in the end, he prepares for a final assault against his foe!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeatable odds begins to frustrate Brooklyn and he increases the intensity of his attacks. Suddenly, when it seems that Kai can't take any more he manages to draw upon his Beyblading spirit and defeat Brooklyn. The crowd goes wild at this dramatic upset and Kai leaves the stadium only to collapse into Tyson's arms, battered and bruised. Brooklyn remains in the stadium, stunned and confused after suffering the first defeat of his Beyblading career. Kai assures his concerned team mates that he's all right and tells Tyson that he should be more concerned with his upcoming battle against Garland. Tyson, as confident as ever, shrugs Kai's advice off but secretly hopes he can summon the same amazing strength that his old friend showed in his battle. Kai walks unsteadily out of the stadium alone, collapses again, and then watches as Dranzer disintegrates in front of him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family principles. But Tyson isn't satisfied' he wants to fight the real Garland, not a book of rules. Tyson convinces Garland to abandon the family code and Beybattle like a true Blader. But can he withstand the full force of Garland unleashed?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter: The Last Mission [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Battle Olympia begins! Gon and team attend, but The Shadow puts a deadly end to the festivities!

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter: Phantom Rouge [English Dub]
programme.desc: Someone has stolen Kurapika's eyes! Gon and Killua investigate, but the Phantom Troupe is back!

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow [English Dub]
programme.desc: Naruto and his team are sent on a mission to guard Yukie Fujikaze, a popular actress starring in the hit movie "The Adventures of Princess Gale."

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic faces off against Dark Oak once again, Eggman has taken control of Blue Typhoon and outside the fortress are Metarex armada led by Red Pine. The situation can't seem to get any more dire when Red Pine and his crew begin to attack their own base.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: As Amy wonders about fate of Shadow, the rest of the crew begin to fix things up around Blue Typhoon they come across a Chaotix ship who had been drifting in space since they last made their delivery to Chris.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Despite not knowing how it might affect Chris, the crew decide to travel through Intergalactic Cloister in hopes of reaching Metarex. The intense distortions inside the cloister knock everyone out inside the Cloister.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ichiro Inuyashiki is a boring office worker who looks like an old man. Even after building them a new home, his family is nothing but ungrateful. One day, Inuyashiki is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Out on a walk to clear his head, a UFO crashes into him, and his body is rebuilt into a deadly robot. He steps in to stop a group of kids from torturing a homeless man when he is knocked unconscious.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. Shishigami has no regard for anybody aside from his best friend and his family, and uses his robot powers to kill indiscriminately. Contrary to Inuyashiki, he feels alive when he is taking the lives of others. What happens when these two meet?

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga Tatsumi is a crazy-strong, ruthless high school delinquent who's nicknamed the "Rampaging Ogre". One day, while dunking some punk, he rescues a big guy who comes ~floating~ down the river. When he does, the big guy splits in half and out pops a bouncing baby boy! But this baby is actually Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV (Baby Beel), the son of the Great Demon Lord, and he came from the Demon World in order to destroy humanity!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga has been chosen to be the parent of Beelzebub, the son of the Great Demon Lord. However Oga's suffering since every time Baby Beel cries he lets out a severe electric shock. Plus, according to Baby Beel's demon maidservant Hildegarde (Hilda), if Baby Beel moves farther than 15 meters away from his human parent Oga, the electric shock will reach lethal levels. Oga shuffles to school with Baby Beel clinging to his back, having no other choice, and begins to search for someone even stronger than him that Baby Beel will take a liking to, in order to get this monkey off his back, literally!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga loses the powdered milk that Hilda prepared for him, and instead buys a bunch of "Yogurty" from a vending machine for Beel. But it turns out that's the favorite drink of one of Ishiyama's Big Four, the "Ishiyama Tohoshinki"; the third year Kanzaki Hajime. Oga hears about how horrible and ruthless a guy Kanzaki is, and runs into the third year classroom to try and dump Baby Beel off on him. When he sees Kanzaki's evil looking face, Oga thinks that this just might be his chance!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaguya, a beautiful woman, separately asks Lupin, Jigen and Goemon to gather the tears of the Yeti, a mermaid's scale, and the liver of a dragon so she can make a secret potion. Unaware that each of them has been given a task, they travel to the far corners of the earth to find these items. Will Kaguya's beloved prince awake from his sleep?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A wealthy shipping magnate and also a bachelor, Onabes' final voyage is nothing short of extravagant, with a ship full of beautiful women and fine art. Things go as planned when Lupin infiltrates the ship disguised as a woman, but things get complicated when Onabes falls in love and proposes to Lupin. Will Lady Lupin be walking down the aisle?

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Those who have prepared to reclaim a nation find their plans exposed. The chaos multiplies after an assassin strikes down a mighty leader in broad daylight, and Alphonse falls prey to monsters in the dark.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: A sinister voice rings out from the shell of Al's armor, and Ed and Greed find themselves under attack. As the Homunculi use the darkness to their advantage, a face from the past arrives to join the battle.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: After investigating the twisted roots of the Bradley family tree, Mustang gathers his most loyal troops. Meanwhile, Ed and his allies continue fighting Selim, who shocks everyone by turning on his own kind.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow [English Dub]
programme.desc: Naruto and his team are sent on a mission to guard Yukie Fujikaze, a popular actress starring in the hit movie "The Adventures of Princess Gale."

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic faces off against Dark Oak once again, Eggman has taken control of Blue Typhoon and outside the fortress are Metarex armada led by Red Pine. The situation can't seem to get any more dire when Red Pine and his crew begin to attack their own base.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: As Amy wonders about fate of Shadow, the rest of the crew begin to fix things up around Blue Typhoon they come across a Chaotix ship who had been drifting in space since they last made their delivery to Chris.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Despite not knowing how it might affect Chris, the crew decide to travel through Intergalactic Cloister in hopes of reaching Metarex. The intense distortions inside the cloister knock everyone out inside the Cloister.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ichiro Inuyashiki is a boring office worker who looks like an old man. Even after building them a new home, his family is nothing but ungrateful. One day, Inuyashiki is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Out on a walk to clear his head, a UFO crashes into him, and his body is rebuilt into a deadly robot. He steps in to stop a group of kids from torturing a homeless man when he is knocked unconscious.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. Shishigami has no regard for anybody aside from his best friend and his family, and uses his robot powers to kill indiscriminately. Contrary to Inuyashiki, he feels alive when he is taking the lives of others. What happens when these two meet?

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart of Istanbul—a city where East meets West, and ancient tradition blends seamlessly with modern life. From the vibrant Spice Bazaar filled with Turkish delight and tea, to Michelin-starred Ottoman cuisine that revives centuries-old royal recipes, Sandra dives deep into the flavors and culture of this mesmerizing destination. She explores the mysterious Basilica Cistern, a hidden underground marvel, and reveals the artistry behind handwoven Turkish carpets—each a story told in knots and color. With practical travel tips, immersive storytelling, and a few laughs along the way, this episode is both a guide and a love letter to one of the world’s most captivating cities. Whether you're drawn to history, food, shopping, or simply want to experience something magical, Istanbul delivers—and this episode shows you why it belongs on every traveler’s bucket list.

programme.title: New Zealand From Above
programme.desc: An aerial journey over New Zealand from the deep south of the South Island to the northern tip of the North Island. We discover the landscapes and meet New Zealanders who talk about their work, interests, and culture.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving in beautiful Mauritius Brent has his first taste of their curry. The Indian population has had a huge influence on the cuisine, but Mauritian curries are unique. Brent meets with Chef Vance to learn the distinctly Mauritian secrets to making curry as he's never made it before. Inspired by his previous trip to South Africa and the distinct textures and tastes of the Mauritian curry he decides to try his own hand at a fusion bunny chow. Heading into the local markets he overcomes language barriers as he struggles to source the ingredients. Finally, baguette in hand, he heads of to the famous colonial house, turned museum, Chateau De LaBourdonnais, where he cooks up at curry amazing feast under the tropical sun and mango trees.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is a multi-ethnic, multilingual and multicultural society. After chatting to his guide, Denis, about his Indian heritage Brent is curious to get to know more about the unique Hindu culture of Mauritius. Travelling deep into the heart of the island he heads to Ganga Talao, a sacred crater lake situated in a secluded mountain area where a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva brings in hundreds of pilgrims every day. There he meets with Priest Dayal who takes him on a tour of Hindu culture and beliefs, opening Brent's eyes to a fascinating part of this multifaceted island. Being ever the adrenalin junky, Brent isn't willing to let the rain put a dampener on his planned quad biking safari. Speeding through the pouring rain, Brent heads to the top of a mountain in the Domaine De L'Etoile Réserve, in hopes of catching a glimpse of the fabled view. He then returns to his apartment and is warmed up by some tasty fusion Indian cooking using the Mauritian staple, Okra.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca le explica a Keka que ella se sentía triste y el Edgar le dio un abrazo de amigos. Keka le comenta que sus hermanos se fueron a ver a Mateo. Lucas y Miguel van a la casa de Trinidad a ver a Mateo, Rebeca los encuentra, los regaña y le anuncia a Trinidad que ellas nunca conseguirán que Leonardo reconozca a Mateo. Cuando llegan a la casa, Keka le cuenta lo del doctor a su abuela. Leo habla con su padre. Le expresa que quiere hacer las cosas bien con María Lucía, y no hacerla sufrir como él hizo con Irene, y le pide que vaya a decirles a Trinidad y Virginia que él es un buen hombre y no piensa abandonarla. Leo, por otra parte, le aconseja a su padre hablarle con el corazón a Irene.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Jimena le cuenta a Leonardo que Keka vio a Rebeca y su doctor abrazándose y le pide que cancelara la ceremonia de renovación de votos. Leonardo no le cree pero se queda pensando al respecto de eso, por lo que, decide ir a preguntarle directamente a Rebeca lo ocurrido. Rebeca inmediatamente desmiente toda situación comprometedora con su doctor y se justifica diciendo que le rompe el corazón que piense que ella lo podría estar engañando. Adolfo amenaza a Rodrigo, debe encontrarla a Alejandra lo antes posible porque si no va a quedar gravemente inculpado en los actos de su novia. Adolfo no confía más en él.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe puso en marcha el proceso de denuncia sobre la declaración de Alejandra, y junto a Carlos Ernesto intentan detener a Adolfo y a Rebeca antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Leo y María Lucía están dispuestos a luchar por su unión, hablan con Virginia y Trinidad y enfrentan a Julio después de enterarse de una mentira que le contó a Trinidad. Leonardo nuevamente intenta, en su última oportunidad antes de casarse, de demostrarle su amor a Irene para que ella lo acepte y así detener la boda. La policía detiene a Rodrigo e intenta llevarlo a la comisaría. En ese momento, la gente de Adolfo comienza a disparar para matar a Rodrigo y le dan un disparo. Tony compró un anillo de compromiso y se le declarará a Maribel.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín es encarcelado y liberado tras meses por Hortensia, quien ignora que Julio César ordenó matarlo. Celia descubre que tiene una enfermedad terminal y lo oculta, aceptando que Ricardo dé su apellido al bebé. Katiuska quema una carta clave y busca dañar al hijo de Celia con brujería. Marcelo solicita el divorcio a Graciela y Misael prepara una prueba de ADN para Glorita, mientras se revela la verdadera naturaleza de Katiuska.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Misael le pide matrimonio a Manuela tras probar su paternidad, mientras Ovidio hace lo mismo con Celia, quien enferma gravemente. Katiuska realiza un ritual de magia negra contra Celia y se compromete con Ricardo. Alejandro se prepara para cumplir la promesa de matar a Néstor. Hortensia descubre que Celia es la madre del hijo de Benjamín y se opone a que lleve su apellido. Finalmente, Celia, Manuela y Elizabeth juran mantener en secreto la inminente muerte de Celia.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia, gravemente enferma, busca el perdón de su hermana. Mientras tanto, Gustavo inaugura su piano bar, evento al que asiste María del Pilar a escondidas. Manuela y Celia descubren con impacto la fiesta de compromiso de Ricardo y Katiuska, lo que desata la furia de Celia. En medio de celebraciones con antifaces y romances nacientes entre Margot y Alejandro, la tragedia golpea cuando Carrero apuñala a Benjamín en su celda y Katiuska recurre a la brujería para retener a Ricardo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia y Manuela interrumpen el compromiso de Ricardo y Katiuska, lo que termina en agresiones. Benjamín es herido en la cárcel por orden de Katiuska. Celia decide ocultar su enfermedad terminal a Ricardo, mientras que Elizabeth, al enterarse del nuevo compromiso de su padre, lo rechaza definitivamente. Alejandro revela que Néstor quedará libre, y Misael, ebrio, acosa a Manuela. Finalmente, Celia echa a Ricardo de su casa tras quitarle las llaves.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín revela que Carero intentó matarlo. Celia sufre una hemorragia y es trasladada de urgencia para una cesárea; Katiuska realiza rituales oscuros deseando su muerte. Marcelo y María del Pilar se reconcilian tras una fuerte discusión por Gustavo. Ricardo acude a la clínica desesperado por la salud de Celia, mientras Manuela se niega a revelarle la verdad. Alejandro decide enfrentar sus problemas en lugar de huir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rene examina a Carmen Rosa y la hospitalizan una semana. Leticia insiste en que Vilma intentó matarla. Consuelo le oculta a Natalia que Erasto la visitó. Marisela y Andreína preparan maletas para Estados Unidos. Chencha llega a la residencia atormentada por su secreto. Erasto compra una quinta a nombre de Natalia mediante Rivera. Eustoquio enfrenta a Erasto amenazándolo de muerte. René revela accidentalmente a Consuelo que Arminda, la tía de Rosa, es la mujer que tenía secuestrada a Natalia. Consuelo grita como loca y cae desmayada al unir los cabos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo se encierra en su cuarto recordando todos los maltratos que dio a Rosa sin saber que era su hija; confiesa a Leticia el descubrimiento. Junior defiende a Rosa de los insultos de Rosalía en la clínica. Alejandro confiesa a Adolfo que Rosa es su hija perdida, horrorizándolo al recordar que espera un hijo de Junior. Chencha confiesa a Blanca la verdad sobre Rosa. Erasto niega a Carmen Rosa toda culpa. Junior se desmaya al levantarse para ir al baño. Adolfo decide llamar a Consuelo para enfrentar la verdad con Rosa.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: José Luis y Natalia se reconcilian. Adolfo descubre por el médico que Junior sufrió parálisis motora y no podrá viajar. Rosa enfrenta a Consuelo en su casa y la expulsa, negándose a oírla y creéndola obsesionada con Isaías. Alejandro confiesa a Rosalía que Rosa es su hermana; ella jura odiarla siempre. Eustoquio se disfraza de Benedicto para enloquecer a Erasto. Adolfo y Marisela suspenden el viaje al exterior. Consuelo, abatida, llama a Adolfo desde el llanto para contarle que Rosa la odia a muerte y le concede toda la razón.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe puso en marcha el proceso de denuncia sobre la declaración de Alejandra, y junto a Carlos Ernesto intentan detener a Adolfo y a Rebeca antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Leo y María Lucía están dispuestos a luchar por su unión, hablan con Virginia y Trinidad y enfrentan a Julio después de enterarse de una mentira que le contó a Trinidad. Leonardo nuevamente intenta, en su última oportunidad antes de casarse, de demostrarle su amor a Irene para que ella lo acepte y así detener la boda. La policía detiene a Rodrigo e intenta llevarlo a la comisaría. En ese momento, la gente de Adolfo comienza a disparar para matar a Rodrigo y le dan un disparo. Tony compró un anillo de compromiso y se le declarará a Maribel.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cuando Guillermo y Ana decidieron no dejar a sus respectivas parejas, no luchar por su amor, no tenían idea de que les iba a resultar imposible. Así es como Ana levantada le pide a su madre un poco más de café, por desvelarse toda la noche pensando en Guillermo. Le cuenta a su madre, y ésta sólo le dice que tiene que olvidarse de Guillermo y seguir adelante con Cristóbal. A pesar de lo mal que se siente Ana, toma la decisión definitiva de olvidar a Guillermo, y ser feliz con Cristóbal. Éste por su parte pasa a buscar a Ana para llevarla al trabajo y regalarle flores. Ana le plantea la posibilidad de casarse cuanto antes. Cristóbal toma muy a gusto el planteo Ana, ya que la sentía dubitativa con respecto al casamiento.

programme.title: Episodio 105
programme.desc: Fabián y Armando llegan a la casa de Finita los dos totalmente borrachos. Finita ni habla | solamente llora. Armando le llama señora Nevera. Ana sigue quejándose con Mauricio de la actitud de Olegario. Mauricio le da una charla del hombre machista latinoamericano. Olegario y Pastor están tomándose unos tragos y hablando de Ana. Ana le pide a Mauricio que se quede más tiempo con ella pero le dice que su mamá está enferma y que tiene mucho trabajo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Toño desconfía de Nayarí, piensa que tiene algo con Gabriel León pero ella niega todo y termina contándole que Deibis es sobrino de Gabriel, o sea, este y el capitán hermanos. Gabriel le jura a Magdalena que él no tiene nada que ver con las fotos que le llegaron y si no fue un Paparazi desconfían de ambos esposos. Luego ella se siente muy culpable y deja bien en claro que no son amantes, es ahí cuando se larga a llover y León le dice que no ha dejado de pensar en ella. Mientras tanto Marilyn y Angie miran las mismas fotos y esta última se enoja mucho porque ve a su marido con otra mujer. Julieta habla con Valentina para que la ayude a hacer un reportaje a Gabriel León y esta acepta.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín revela que Carero intentó matarlo. Celia sufre una hemorragia y es trasladada de urgencia para una cesárea; Katiuska realiza rituales oscuros deseando su muerte. Marcelo y María del Pilar se reconcilian tras una fuerte discusión por Gustavo. Ricardo acude a la clínica desesperado por la salud de Celia, mientras Manuela se niega a revelarle la verdad. Alejandro decide enfrentar sus problemas en lugar de huir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto irrumpe en casa de Consuelo y exige llevarse a Natalia, pero ella se niega y él promete vengarse. Marisela exige a Adolfo evitar que Rosa tenga el niño. Alejandro le explica a Carmen Rosa lo del parentesco con Rosa y la convence de ayudar. Junior se compromete a casarse con Rosa pase lo que pase. Rosa decide casarse con Junior contra todos. Eustoquio sigue aterrorizando a Erasto disfrazado. Carmen Rosa duda en revelar el secreto. Consuelo decide ir a hablar con Rosa de nuevo, esta vez con calma. Isaías medita sobre la situación imposible.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo está dispuesto a decirle a Carlos Ernesto quién asesinó a su hermano Miguel Ferrándiz a cambio de protección legal. Leonardo, que ahora sabe que es el padre de Mateo, no sabe si casarse con Rebeca es la decisión correcta. E Irene no quiere pedirle que la deje porque es él quien debe decidirlo. Tony lleva a Maribel a un restaurante de lujo para pedirle matrimonio, pero ella sufre un pequeño percance. Leo se pelea con su madre porque ella le prohíbe salir con María Lucía. Julio cuenta que Leo no es hijo de Leonardo.

programme.title: Mistrust
programme.desc: Al no tener compromisos y nunca ser vulnerable, Veronica disfruta de ser una amante. Se da cuenta de que su mejor amiga tiene la llave de su corazón y es la única capaz de extraer sus emociones.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Mientras el Dr. Blunt realiza un experimento de telepatía con una chinchilla, que deja su mente temporalmente atrapada en el cuerpo del animal, el Equipo Astro investiga los misterios del teatro "embrujado". Suzu sube al escenario y canta. ¡Ay! Astro y Astro-Kitty piensan que su voz chillona debería ser suficiente para espantar a cualquier fantasma, pero los ruidos inquietantes continúan hasta que el Equipo Astro descubre al enamorado Derek, un ave lira capaz de reproducir cualquier sonido humano, los cuales incorpora en una canción con la esperanza de atraer a una pareja. Él y Suzu cantan a dúo y casi "echan abajo el teatro" cuando sus voces funden el cableado defectuoso de los micrófonos y provocan un incendio. El Equipo Astro apaga el fuego y salva el teatro y, para sorpresa de todos, la canción de Derek le consigue una pareja.

programme.title: Papi
programme.desc: Papi narra un día en la vida de Sonia, una niña de 8 años con una imaginación vibrante. Sus recuerdos y vuelos de fantasía surrealistas arrojan luz sobre su relación con su padre, conocido solo como el elusivo figura de "Papi". La joven soñadora Sonia enfrenta el dolor del abandono aferrándose a sus recuerdos de un héroe que aparece, pero nunca llega.

programme.title: Cualquier Cosa es Posible

programme.title: La Vendedora de Rosas
programme.desc: Mónica tiene 13 años y ya ha creado su propio mundo¸ en la calle¸ donde lucha con coraje para defender lo poco que tiene: sus amigas¸ su novio¸ que vende droga¸ y su dignidad y su orgullo que no le hace concesiones a nadie. En la noche de Navidad¸ como todas las noches¸ vende rosas para ganarse la vida. Pero la vida le depara una nueva cita con la soledad¸ la pobreza¸ la droga y la muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena se enfrenta en la cárcel a otras presas que la provocan, y se descubre que ella es la viuda del Señor de los Cielos. A petición de Rutila, Aurelio acepta reunirse con Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de un enfrentamiento en el hospital, rodean a Leonor y Ramos, quienes tienen que dejar escapar a Heriberto. Para probar su lealtad al Chema, Ernesto mata a uno de los hombres de Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema escapa de la cárcel con ayuda de Tijeras. Sin saberlo, Elsa firma los papeles que garantizan la fuga. Ella y Victoria siguen adelante con sus campañas por el Gobierno de Jalisco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El padre Lázaro no puede con la presión: quiere hablar con el obispo. Ernesto le pide a Chacorta que le dé un susto. Finalmente, en la casa de Danilo, Victoria y Aurelio se conocen.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los hombres de Chacorta descubren que el padre Lázaro iba a hablar con Garnica, y lo silencian; no dejan cabos sueltos. Por recuperar a su hijo, Matilde está decidida a entregar a Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: A Matilde le tortura la idea de no volver a ver a su hijo, y el Chema le sugiere que lo secuestre. Leonor desconfía del suicidio del padre Lázaro: le pide a Garnica que presione a los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria y Danilo se besan, y ella no sospecha que se está enamorando de Aurelio Casillas. Ambos confiesan sentirse atraídos el uno por el otro. Mónica confirma su embarazo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica quiere sorprender a Aurelio con su embarazo, pero se lo encuentra en la cama con Victoria. Se hace pasar por su hermana y, a solas, jura no perdonarlo si él se enamora de otra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria sube en las encuestas y eso preocupa a Elsa, quien, en un intento desesperado por ganar votantes, le propone a Max cerrar Villa Catalina. El Chema comienza a interesarse en Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa visita a Victoria y le propone una tregua para trabajar juntas contra el narcotráfico. Max está dispuesto a perder el juicio de Ximena para demostrar con quién está su fidelidad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema ordena la emboscada para recuperar al hijo de Matilde; cuando ella se arrepiente, ya es demasiado tarde. Mientras trata de escapar con sus nietos, doña Alba es brutalmente herida.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba es sometida a una cirugía, ha perdido mucha sangre y se debate entre la vida y la muerte. Aurelio sospecha que Matilde y el Chema están detrás. Ximena es condenada a prisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio averigua quién es en verdad el escolta de Matilde, y le dice que se despida de su hijo. Los Casillas le declaran la guerra al Chema, y averiguan dónde se esconden sus hombres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde trata de reconciliarse con Chacorta, pero ya tiene los minutos contados: él no le perdona la traición. Lo importante ahora para los Casillas es hacer pagar al Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena se enfrenta en la cárcel a otras presas que la provocan, y se descubre que ella es la viuda del Señor de los Cielos. A petición de Rutila, Aurelio acepta reunirse con Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de un enfrentamiento en el hospital, rodean a Leonor y Ramos, quienes tienen que dejar escapar a Heriberto. Para probar su lealtad al Chema, Ernesto mata a uno de los hombres de Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema escapa de la cárcel con ayuda de Tijeras. Sin saberlo, Elsa firma los papeles que garantizan la fuga. Ella y Victoria siguen adelante con sus campañas por el Gobierno de Jalisco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto y Leonor se enfrentan por última vez. Él descubre la emboscada, pero no puede escapar de su suerte. Moribundo, asegura que ella se ha convertido en lo que tanto combatió, una asesina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de Heriberto, Aurelio declara la guerra para vengarlo: tiene ganas de matar a medio mundo. Todos se preparan para lo peor. Victoria le pone más protección a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio envía a Chacorta para ajustar cuentas con Leonor e Ignacio por la muerte de Heriberto: la orden es asesinarlos a todos. Ximena está desconsolada, y culpa a su exesposo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ignacio intenta interrogar al Manotas, pero la rabia se lo impide, y lo mata. Comienza a vengarse de todos los que participaron en la muerte de su padre. Victoria gana las elecciones.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa insiste en reunirse con el Chema, pero ya no tiene mucho que ofrecerle, y él le envenena la comida. Ernesto confiesa a su nuevo patrón que Aurelio está vivo, y le busca pruebas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila escapa con Ernesto con la esperanza de vivir juntos, y Aurelio se desespera porque sus hombres no logran encontrarla. Chacorta presiona a Víctor para que le dé información.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ernesto presenta a Rutila su nuevo jefe, que resulta ser el enemigo número uno de su padre. Aurelio le ordena a Lilo encontrar a su hija, y sospechan que su fuga está vinculada con el Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila tiene miedo, y le dice a Ernesto que la tiene que sacar de la casa de Chema lo más rápido posible. La orden es tratarla como una reina, pues aseguran que no saldrá viva de ahí.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria investiga la desaparición de Elsa, y Lucila le asegura que le contará toda la verdad sobre la relación de su jefa y el Chema. Aurelio le pide a Lay averiguar el paradero de Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema le dice a Rutila que Ernesto los traicionó a ella y a Aurelio, y le muestra una foto como prueba. Luego pide que Lay le diga a los Casillas que él tiene el tesoro que están buscando.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio teme por la seguridad de Victoria, y le sugiere que traslade a Ernesto a otro lugar. Mientras tanto, doña Alba le aconseja a Ximena que aproveche el caos y se vaya con Luzma y Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Danilo toma a Mónica como rehén, y ella le confiesa que está embarazada para ganar tiempo. En cuanto él se distrae, ella lo mata. Con rabia, Aurelio amenaza al Chema por teléfono.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Nos adentramos en el mundo de la Lucha Libre Mexicana junto a Tinieblas y Tinieblas Jr. Una dinastía que ha llevado el espectáculo, la fuerza y la tradición de este deporte a lo más alto. Entre anécdotas de entrenamientos, giras internacionales y combates memorables, padre e hijo comparten cómo se vive la lucha desde dentro y lo que significa portar una máscara que es símbolo y herencia. Hablamos de la disciplina detrás del cuadrilátero, de la conexión con el público, de la evolución de la lucha libre a lo largo de los años y del compromiso de mantener vivo un legado familiar. Un episodio lleno de historia, orgullo y la energía única que solo se siente cuando suena la campana.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Ricardo Olavarrieta, expatinador artístico y pionero del deporte en México, quien nos comparte su trayectoria desde que descubrió su pasión por el patinaje a los seis años hasta representar a México en los Juegos Olímpicos de Invierno de Calgary 1988 y Albertville 1992. Además, comparte sus experiencias como competidor y especialista técnico, la creación de la Federación Mexicana de Patinaje y su participación en la formación de nuevas generaciones de atletas. Entre recuerdos de sus competencias, la emoción de estar en los Juegos Olímpicos y la evolución del patinaje artístico en Latinoamérica, Ricardo Olavarrieta nos ofrece una mirada inspiradora sobre la pasión, la constancia y la dedicación necesarias para sobresalir en un deporte de alto rendimiento.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Conocemos el lado más humano y deportivo de Melvin Brown, exfutbolista profesional mexicano. A través de una conversación íntima y dinámica, el programa recorre su trayectoria desde sus inicios en Cruz Azul Hidalgo, donde el deporte formó parte esencial de su infancia, hasta su consolidación como figura clave en equipos como Cruz Azul y Jaguares, de Chiapas. Melvin comparte momentos decisivos de su carrera como su llegada a las fuerzas básicas del Cruz Azul a los 17 años, su debut en primera división, su experiencia en la Copa Libertadores del 2001, y cómo enfrentó lesiones, presiones y decisiones técnicas que marcaron su rumbo, como no jugar en el Mundial.

programme.title: La primera ametralladora del Oeste
programme.desc: Un hombre secuestra a la esposa de un comandante de caballería para intercambiarla por una pistola Gatling que está siendo vendida por un traficante de armas.

programme.title: El regreso de Aleluya
programme.desc: El regreso de Aleluya - Aleluya es contratada por un incompetente revolucionario mexicano para recuperar un ídolo azteca perdido, con el que podrá conseguir la ayuda de las tribus nativas en su desafortunado levantamiento. Sin embargo, un símbolo tan poderoso tiene sus atractivos para un amplio abanico de individuos.

programme.title: La caravana más divertida del Oeste
programme.desc: Cuatro episodios de "El rastro de Dusty" (1973) unidos en una película. Como en "La Isla de Gilligan", Dusty es un torpe ayudante de capataz que, por accidente, separa a su grupo de la caravana y los pierde en el desierto. Juntos intentarán encontrar el camino de regreso mientras enfrentan divertidas desventuras.

programme.title: La sombra de Sartana es la sombra de tu muerte
programme.desc: La sombra de Sartana es la sombra de tu muerte - Sartana tiene una recompensa por su cabeza y se le busca vivo o muerto. Para eliminarla, hace un trato con los políticos locales. Si da caza a los merodeadores hermanos Randal, se eliminará la recompensa.

programme.title: El hombre de la diligencia
programme.desc: Un juez se encuentra con un hombre (Frank Latimore) al que una vez perjudicó tras un ataque apache. El ataque le obliga a él, a su prometida y a sus compañeros de diligencia a refugiarse en un área de descanso.

programme.title: Y dejaron de llamarle Camposanto
programme.desc: John y George McIntire son un par de ingenuos hermanos que viajan a un pueblo occidental sin ley para ver a su padre.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 43, 44, 45
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Sin aliento
programme.desc: Un robo importante fracasa cuando dos jóvenes se ven atrapados entre bandidos mexicanos y un empresario sin escrúpulos, todos dispuestos a todo por recuperar el botín perdido. En medio del caos, los jóvenes deberán luchar por sobrevivir y decidir en quién pueden confiar.

programme.title: El tesoro del lago de plata
programme.desc: Tras el asalto a una diligencia y el asesinato de su padre, Fred Engel se une a Old Shatterhand y Winnetou para recuperar un mapa del tesoro dividido en dos. Su búsqueda los lleva hasta Silver Lake, donde deberán adelantarse a la banda del coronel Brinkley, decidida a hacerse con el oro.

programme.title: Bounty Hunter in Trinity
programme.desc: Los habitantes de Trinidad deciden contratar a un famoso cazarrecompensas para protegerse de una feroz banda de forajidos mexicanos que están aterrorizando la zona.

programme.title: Las campanas de San Angelo
programme.desc: Gridley contrabandea plata desde México usando un pasaje secreto. El guardia Roy Rogers lo descubre y envía a Lee Madison por ayuda, pero ella es capturada. Con refuerzos y la ayuda de Trigger, Roy intenta rescatarla y frenar el plan de Gridley.

programme.title: Amor con amor se paga
programme.desc: Durante la Revolución Mexicana, Valentina se encuentra dividida entre dos hombres muy distintos: el hijo de un rico despiadado y un pobre conflictivo con afición a la bebida. Ambos buscan conquistar su corazón, mientras Valentina deberá decidir entre dos caminos marcados por el amor, las diferencias sociales y el turbulento contexto de la revolución.

programme.title: El tren de la muerte
programme.desc: Un misterioso solitario llega en tren a la aldea de “Paradise Valley” y se instala en el salón regentado por Vilma. Allí descubre un ambiente marcado por constantes enfrentamientos entre dos bandas rivales. Su llegada podría alterar el frágil equilibrio del lugar.

programme.title: Oeste sin fronteras
programme.desc: Un soldado confederado marginado se redime defendiendo a una mujer de unos bandidos dispuestos a matar por su mina de oro.

programme.title: Jim Golden Poker
programme.desc: Djurado es un jugador profesional armado que llega a la pequeña ciudad de Silver Mine y gana la mitad del saloon local, la otra parte de la cual pertenece a Barbara, mientras lucha contra el notorio forajido Tucan.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Veinte años después, la familia del artista Dmitri llega a una ciudad costera de vacaciones con Ksenia y su hija Rita. Al recibir una invitación a la reunión escolar, Ksenia no puede negarse: en el fondo, muere por ver de nuevo a Piotr. Pero es Rita, de 19, quien se cruza primero con él, rescatada por Piotr de un peligro. Ahora periodista y editor respetado, con una historia explosiva sobre corrupción en antiguas propiedades del partido, Piotr empieza a sentir atracción por la joven.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de Rita, pero él no piensa repetir el error de dejar ir a su gran amor: está decidido a luchar por ella. Rita responde igual de firme: no renunciará a Piotr por sus padres. Mientras crece el escándalo de las casas estatales, Edik, colega de Piotr, descubre que intervienen su teléfono, vinculado a la élite política. La amenaza se vuelve real cuando dos desconocidos irrumpen en la redacción exigiendo el expediente, o la familia de Piotr pagará el precio.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Por seguridad, Pyotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres, y logra una tregua temporal con Ksenia. Pero cuando entrega su artículo para la próxima edición, órdenes "desde arriba" retiran toda la tirada acusándolo de difamación. Dmitri, sin renunciar a separar a la pareja, se reúne con Aleksandr, el exnovio de Rita e instructor del centro náutico, y le da su bendición para reconquistarla... con una condición: deshacerse de Pyotr.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Pyotr y Ksenia se aman desde hace años y sueñan con formar una familia justo cuando terminan sus estudios. Pero el padre de Ksenia, dueño de una constructora, es acusado de lavado de dinero a gran escala y podría perderlo todo, incluida su libertad. Entonces aparece Grigory Dmitrievich, un viejo conocido de la familia con poder en la administración local, dispuesto a salvarlo... a cambio de una sola condición: que Ksenia se case con su hijo Dima, un joven que estudia pintura.

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Marco Lino Niño, Ana Julia Sánchez y Rosa Helena Restrepo sufrieron maltratos en hogares geriátricos, resultando en sus muertes. Sus familias buscan justicia y denuncian negligencia y maltrato. Las investigaciones están en curso, mientras los hogares siguen operando.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Tres hombres, acusados injustamente de abusos, luchan por su libertad tras años de cárcel y sufrimiento. A pesar de pruebas que demuestran su inocencia, la verdad tardó demasiado en salir a la luz. ¿Quién paga por el daño de una falsa denuncia?

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: El miedo a las represalias ha impedido que las víctimas denuncien delitos en Colombia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Dos niños con dificultades médicas tienen un sueño por cumplir.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Melany Amaya, de 16 años, desapareció tras asistir a una fiesta electrónica en Medellín en junio de 2018. Tras siete días de búsqueda, una llamada anónima alertó a su madre. Su cuerpo fue hallado en un potrero del sector "El Calvario".

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: EL caso de un asesinato planeado por una pareja, para quitar del medio a un humilde carpintero con el objetivo quedarse con su fortuna. Hoy los hijos, del ahora difunto, exigen justicia para que los verdaderos culpables paguen las consecuencias de sus actos.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Valentina Mugno, de 14 años, fue hallada asesinada en su casa en Valledupar en 2011, tras quedar sola una noche. La investigación inicial involucró falsamente a un amigo y a su hermana antes de identificar a Víctor Alfonso Márquez como sospechoso. Una segunda víctima que logró sobrevivir un ataque similar fue clave para el caso. Casi seis años después, Márquez fue condenado a 44 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 23 de junio de 2014 en Chinchiná, Alfair Sabogal atacó brutalmente a seis miembros de una familia por celos e intentó matar a su pareja, Diana Marín, quien quedó con secuelas visuales.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Calarcá, Quindío, las primas Luz Enith y Jenny Andrea Morales fueron halladas estranguladas en 2016. La investigación reveló que Jenny mantenía una relación con su ex esposo, Fabián Rendón, quien motivado por celos y venganza planeó el doble feminicidio junto a su cómplice Sebastián Muriel, administrador de un hotel local. Fabián confesó el crimen y señaló a Muriel como coautor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Ángela Carolina fue hallada muerta en Villa Rica, Tolima. John Fredy, movido por odio hacia su esposa infiel, confesó el crimen y fue condenado a 36 años por el asesinato de Carolina y su esposa. Luego intentó cambiar su versión, sin éxito.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Una niña indígena es asesinada cerca de la Sierra Nevada. Se investiga y descubren la implicación de su primo y Nefer Niño, este último contratado por celos. La investigación revela más tras 7 meses.

programme.title: Juez Mom

programme.title: Juez Mom

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.

programme.title: Juez Mom

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Ricardo pasó de guerrillero a productor de insectos, usando moscas para la paz y el medio ambiente.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Jenifer y Ángela, separadas por el desastre de Armero, descubren ser hermanas tras 34 años. Una vive en España como periodista, la otra en Colombia luchando como madre soltera. La Fundación Armando Armero une familias que perdieron todo.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Tres historias: William Trujillo revive el horror de haber sido secuestrado y abusado por Luis Alfredo Garavito, "La Bestia", en 1979 a sus 9 años. programme.title: Caso
programme.desc: En 1992, el asesinato de una joven en el garaje de su casa en Zaragoza. Durante años, la policía trata de cercar a los sospechosos.

programme.desc: Vanessa, joven de 21 años que, desde niña, lucha contra su mala fortuna, encuentra motivos para vivir al nacer su bebé. Solo cuatro meses después, madre e hijo desaparecen repentinamente.

From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.
